title: chamaemelum macrophyllum
intro: Chamaemelum macrophyllum, commonly known as English chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that has been used for centuries in herbal medicine. The health benefits of English chamomile include its ability to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety, as well as its soothing effects on digestive issues and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of English chamomile include apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
